title: 3 story large home
content: The past 2 nights I have experienced a new place in mall word . It’s a large 3 story home , many people in the house, many different rooms . The upstairs is almost like a maze . I feel like the back yard is on the on the bay, large backyard with grass that’s then connected to water. Has anyone else experienced a new place that is a large home the past few days? Or does this place sound familiar?
